Great purple combo for toning away yellow color. I love the smell! The shampoo didn’t make much foam, but when I rinsed my hair and applied again there was a lot of foam. I’m allergic to most shampoo brands probably because of the parabens, but I have no allergic reaction after using this brand which means it doesn’t have harmful ingredients, yay!

(I'm posting this review from my partner's profile, as we shop from his Amazon Prime)  I have been using purple shampoos and conditioners for my blond hair for many years. Recently I've tried this brand and it became my favorite so far. It really works well, does what it supposed to do and very suitable for my thin hair. So I am with confidence giving it 5 Stars.  Elena

I absolutely love this shampoo/conditioner! My hair is very long "middle of bottom",greys throughout and this stuff is amazing. Not only does it make my hair feel like silk the beautiful smell is still there days later I highly recommend to anyone with silver/grey hair as this will keep the colors amazing.

reviews.t: Great for toning blonde hair/ highlights!
reviews.x: Great shampoo/ conditioner for toning blonde hair. Took the brassiness out on the first use and has a much more pleasant scent than ShimmerLights. The conditioner isn’t as deeply moisturizing as I hoped it would be, but I used a little leave in and it felt soft and healthy. Very happy with the price, the product and the fast delivery! Also, the packaging is so pretty and fun! Highly recommend for color treated hair.

Since I bought these items I have had used twice and so far I like it.  My hair is smooth and smell good after washed.  I have some gray hair and so far it does not look yellowish, will see what happens after keep using it.  But so far I can give the product 5 starts.

reviews.t: Prevent from getting yellowish, helps to keep cold tint
reviews.x: It’s not the first time I order for this company products for my hair . Always satisfied with delivery, packaging, texture, scent, quality of the product overall. This one for blond hair didn’t disappoint neither. After coloring it prevents your hair from getting yellowish, helps  to keep the cold tint .

reviews.t: Good purple DYE DEPOSITING shampoo and conditioner
reviews.x: This shampoo smells like the stuff often used when I’m at the salon- very fresh and clean, with a very mild hint of floral. Be aware this is a purple color depositing shampoo. Meaning, you are literally depositing small amounts of purple dye to your hair when you shampoo and condition. The purple dye color cancels out brassy orange colors that develop on blond and silver hair. You should not use this as a daily/maintenance shampoo. reviews.t: It works! I love how my hair look and feel!
reviews.x: The shampoo and the conditioner are nicely packed in a quality box. I love that these products as they are paraben and sulphate free. My hair feel nourished, nice and silky, easy to manage after I use this shampoo and the conditioner. They really work well giving my hair cold brighter tone. Also I love it is sulphate free, as I do cold botox treatment for my hair couple times a year and sulphate free shampoo is essential for treatment to last longer.  It has been my favorite shampoo+conditioner

If you want a natural purple tone without chemicals this shampoo/conditioning set is for you.  Also, has a lovely scent and leaves my hair soft and shiny.  I just purchased another set for my mother because she loved my purple hair color.

reviews.t: Great quality purple shampoo & conditioner for my daughter's naturally blonde hair with highlights!
reviews.x: My daughter has a natural dirty blonde hair color with some blonde balayage mixed in and this purple shampoo and conditioner really helps to keep her blonde from appearing brassy/yellow. Great for twice a week use and maintenance of her color. Love that it is sulfate free and these bottles are large enough that they will last her quite some time.

Works really great at toning and getting the brassiness out of your hair. It's definitely a great deal with not only a large shampoo but also a conditioner combo for a great price.  I can't say anything about moisturizer bc I used this after bleaching my hair blonde. Overall I would buy it again,  it fixed the uneven blonde in my hair

This was averted for light blonde or silver gray hair. Maybe it’s great for blonde, but if you have gray or silvery gray hair, it comes out lavender. My ten year old grandson thought purple hair was cool but I had to wash it out. In bright sunlight it went from lavender to purple. I tossed it out after one shampoo. Money wasted.

reviews.t: Rich purple color with a great scent.
reviews.x: Super impressed with the packaging. Love the design but even more impressed with the deep purple color of both the shampoo and the conditioner. Light clean scent. Nice size bottles. I included a size comparison of airpods so you can get an idea of the size of the bottles.  Will definitely reorder!

reviews.t: The conditioner smells a little funny, but the products work well.
reviews.x: I have used other "purple shampoos," and they were hard to rinse from my hair and left stains on the tile. This product rinses out easily and no stains on tile. The conditioner smells a little odd when putting it in your hair, but it is fine once you rinse it out. I would recommend.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant scent of the shampoo and conditioner.
Many reviewers say the product effectively tones brassiness and keeps blonde, silver, or grey hair from turning yellow.
Several reviewers report the purple dye deposits too strongly, leaving hair purple or not rinsing out thoroughly.
Some reviewers find the conditioner less moisturizing or less pleasant than the shampoo.
A few reviewers mention the product is paraben- and sulphate-free and gentle on sensitive scalps.
